reasons.persona_fit: Directly addresses small business owners in Bareni's calm, practical voice; respects human approval boundaries and the no-CTA rule.
reasons.clarity: Logical progression from decision framing to a concrete mapping exercise and diagnostic question, all in clear, plain language.
reasons.actionability: Provides a practical, pen-and-paper method to map approval gates and evaluate whether a repeatable workflow is suitable for automation.
